title: Experts disagree on this request
context:
Chief architect: Landing the work in order A to F, with the contract test green after each commit, is the risk control for a change this large on stage hooks. The non-goals, the receipt-as-measure and the per-area criteria claims all fit inside it and stay as written.

Target: this request
- solution-architect: non-goals stated: no auto GitHub issues from debt, no debt dashboard list, no commit moving/cherry-pick/rebase, no check logic moved into the mod, no hook decision changed except the recorded Allow once
- product-owner: the request bundles three issues and about 30 work items into one PR; small commits in the order A (tech debt), B (organization deployment), C (rule stop), D (fix proof), E (what ships), F (HUD) let each slice be reviewed and kept green on its own
- product-owner: no product measure is needed beyond the receipt itself: success is that the receipt and the PR show tech debt, fix proof and what ships honestly
- qa-engineer: scope covers about 30 behaviours across three issues; each work item A to F needs its own criterion set and test file so a red check names one area, and the 95% branch-coverage floor applies to every new verb
